locationNotes.gym: Holmes Place · cable tower + machines. All primary exercises run on the cable tower — constant tension, exact progression.
locationNotes.home: Everything at home runs on the Rayofi Go-Tone Pro: motor-controlled resistance from 3 to 30 kg, dialled in rather than stacked, anchored to a doorframe, a chair, or your own foot. One quick-attach handle ships with it; the second is for the two-handed moves. There is only one unit, so anything that would be a wide-bar two-hand pull at the gym goes one arm at a time here, and the rep counts say so. Rayofi's manual gives no anchor height per exercise — their videos do, worth watching once per new movement.
locationNotes.travel: The Rayofi Go-Tone Pro is the entire travel kit — under a kilo, anchors to any door. Same one-unit rules as at home: the pulls go one arm at a time, and the second handle covers the two-handed moves.

fullBody.title: Full Body
fullBody.focus: side delt · lat · chest · back · rear delt · legs + core maintenance
fullBody.note: Same session both gym days. Nine exercises to keep it near an hour — face pull, biceps curl, hamstring curl and the cable crunch are the ones left out; add any of them back if the hour has room.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise
exercises.cue: Fresh first — the most important move for the look. Constant tension at the bottom, where a dumbbell would give you none. Arm slightly bent, lead with the elbow to shoulder height. Goal: a clean 15, then 6 kg.

exercises.name: Wide Lat Pulldown
exercises.cue: Second most important taper muscle after the side delt. Pull the bar to the upper chest, feel the lats, controlled on the way back. Replaces the pull-up you cut — that would have thickened the upper traps and shortened the neckline.

exercises.name: Cable Chest Press (high-to-low)
exercises.cue: Anchor high, stand away from the tower, press forward and downward in front of the chest. The downward angle hits the upper chest automatically — the athletic line under the collarbone.

exercises.name: Cable Row (neutral)
exercises.cue: Sit upright, handle to the belly, elbows close to the body, shoulder blades together. Builds posture without thickening the neck — stay moderate, don't heave.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Fly (Cable)
exercises.cue: Gives the shoulder depth and the 3D look without mass. Arms almost straight, lead with the little fingers, squeeze the rear delts together.

exercises.name: Triceps Pushdown (Rope)
exercises.cue: Elbows fixed at your sides, pull the rope apart at the bottom, brief hold. A defined arm, not mass.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust (Dumbbell or Sandbag)
exercises.cue: Maintenance — hold, don't build. Shoulders against a bench, the weight across the hips, full hip extension, 1s hold at the top.

exercises.name: Leg Press (light)
exercises.cue: Maintenance — hold, don't build. High reps, light weight, never progress. Keeps the legs lean and defined without making them thicker.

exercises.name: Hollow Hold
exercises.cue: Lower back flat on the floor, arms long. Builds the deep abdominal tension that visually tightens the waist.

solo.title: eGym
solo.focus: full body — eGym sets the resistance
solo.note: Always eGym on Mondays. The machines pick and adjust resistance themselves, so there's nothing to plan a load, set count or RIR for here.

exercises.name: eGym
exercises.cue: Whatever the eGym circuit is that day — machine-guided, full body.

rain.title: Full Body — Rayofi
rain.day: Home · rain stand-in for Tue/Wed or Sun
rain.focus: the gym Full Body, run on the Rayofi instead
rain.note: Your gym days are Tue (Wed on conference weeks) and Sun. This is the same Full Body session for the days the weather stops the trip. Leg press becomes a squat and the row goes one-armed; otherwise the same nine movements in the same order. If Eunice is rained out the same day you take turns on the one unit — her list is her own.

exercises.name: Rayofi Lateral Raise (one arm)
exercises.cue: Fresh first — the taper driver. Lead with the elbow to shoulder height, constant tension, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Rayofi Lat Pulldown (kneeling, one arm)
exercises.cue: Anchor high, kneel, pull the elbow down and out, squeeze the lat. Only one Rayofi, so this is one arm at a time — both sides make one set.

exercises.name: Rayofi Chest Press
exercises.cue: Anchor low behind you, stand away from the anchor, press forward and slightly down in front of the chest.

exercises.name: Rayofi Row (one arm)
exercises.cue: Upright, pull the elbow to the ribs, shoulder blades together, no swing. Only one Rayofi, so this is one arm at a time — both sides make one set.

exercises.name: Rayofi Rear Delt Pull-Apart
exercises.cue: Both handles on the one cable — arms almost straight, apart to the chest, lead with the little fingers.

exercises.name: Rayofi Triceps Pushdown
exercises.cue: Anchor high, elbows fixed at your sides, press down until straight, brief squeeze.

exercises.name: Rayofi Hip Thrust
exercises.cue: Maintenance — hold, don't build. Cable over the hips, shoulders supported, full extension, 1s at the top.

exercises.name: Rayofi Squat (light)
exercises.cue: Maintenance, standing in for the leg press. Handles at the shoulders, high reps, light. Just hold the legs.

exercises.name: Hollow Hold
exercises.cue: No equipment. Lower back flat on the floor, arms long.

fri.title: Shared Session
fri.note: One Rayofi, one exercise at a time: his set, her set, his set is her rest. Only one unit, so anything that is a wide-bar two-hand pull at the gym — lat pulldown, row — is one arm at a time here, alternating sides within the set, and the rep counts below are per side. The rear delt pull-apart is the exception: that is what the second handle is for, both hands on the one cable. Loads are placeholders. The Rayofi tops out around 30 kg, well under the gym cable loads, so fill in real numbers after the first session instead of carrying gym or band numbers across.

exercises.name: Rayofi Lateral Raise (one arm)
exercises.cue: Already one-arm even at the gym cable tower. Lead with the elbow to shoulder height, constant tension, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Rayofi Lat Pulldown (kneeling, one arm)
exercises.cue: One handle, one Rayofi — anchor high via the door anchor, kneel, pull one elbow down and out, squeeze the lat, then switch sides. Both sides count as one set.

exercises.name: Rayofi Row (one arm)
exercises.cue: One handle — sit facing the anchor, pull one elbow to the ribs, no swing, switch sides. Both sides count as one set.

exercises.name: Rayofi Hip Thrust
exercises.cue: Cable anchored low, shoulders supported, squeeze 2s at the top.

exercises.name: Rayofi Rear Delt Pull-Apart
exercises.cue: Handle in each hand (the second handle is for this), apart to the chest, lead with the little fingers.

exercises.name: Rayofi Biceps Curl (one arm)
exercises.cue: One handle. Elbow fixed at your side, slow on the way down, then switch sides.

cardioProtocol.context: Why this exists at all: July on the road ran 8,000+ steps a day and dropped the most weight of any month. Zone 2 is the deliberate version of that — the part that does not depend on the day going well.

zone2.note: at 4 km/h lands around ~100 bpm — Zone 1, too low
zone2.appleWatchSetup: Workout → Indoor Walk → ... → Heart Rate → Range 106-124 bpm, vibrates on drift
zone2.eveningRule: after 20:00 Zone 1 only (under 100 bpm) — Zone 2 late disrupts sleep
zone2.adhdBonus: even 100 bpm rhythmic walking regulates dopamine/noradrenaline — never wasted

stepTarget.parkingHack: park on the residential street before the destination rather than the lot — about a 5 min walk each way, same spot every time, no detour. ~1800 steps round trip, ~9000/week
stepTarget.badWeather: park in the lot — no penalty rule
stepTarget.evening: pad during show/podcast, Zone 1, effortless NEAT
stepTarget.why: +3000 steps/day ≈ 200-250 kcal without compensation — bigger lever than the weight gap alone

philipp.primaryRule: start low in rep range (e.g. 12), climb over weeks to 15 across all sets, then raise load and drop back to 12. Side delt target: clean 15 → 6kg. Pulldown/row/chest: +2.5kg when all sets hit top of range. RIR 2 non-negotiable.
philipp.maintenanceRule: 2 sets, same weight as last time, RIR 3, never progress — one number, no decision
philipp.missedSessionRule: never two in a row. One missed session is life, two is a pattern. Friday's shared Rayofi session is the safety net — minimum 1x/week structurally guaranteed.
philipp.deload: every 6-8 weeks, 1 light week at ~60%. Err earlier if sleep or appetite go off — cortisol is the enemy of muscle retention.

eunice.primaryRule: form before load; on glutes she can push closer to failure (RIR 1-2)
eunice.mindMuscle: squeeze and hold at the top of every rep — feeling the muscle matters more than the number
eunice.formFirst: a clean rep beats a heavy one you don't feel in the target muscle
eunice.deload: every 8 weeks, 1 light week — needed less often than Philipp since she's building, not cutting

_gaps: Sessions still duplicate exercise objects instead of referencing exercises.json by id
Every Rayofi load is unset — both people, every shared and optional session. Nothing to progress from until the device has actually been used once.
Hip Thrust (Dumbbell or Sandbag) has no demo video; it replaced the glute drive machine on 2026-08-29. None of the Rayofi or eGym entries have one either, and no video exists to link for them yet.

No warm-up anywhere in this file — zero sessions describe one. The gym Full Body opens on a lateral raise and reaches a 42.5 kg row by the fourth exercise, which wants a ramp set. Adding one is a training decision, not a data fix.
Eunice's Monday is recorded as 'eGym' with no station list, because the machines pick and progress the resistance themselves. Nothing about that session is trackable here, by design.
